scope: Query metadata and source support only. No fresh C13 data, target truth, predictions, local MRR or historical leaderboard outcomes read.

prospective_population.unit: One molecule query with its original complete usable acquisition set; never select one scan for convenience.
prospective_population.sources: At least two documented external acquisition sources, including a timsTOF source; source held out from candidate-model selection.
prospective_population.sampling: Deterministic seeded draw within ionization-mode/canonical-adduct/instrument/acquisition-count strata, independent of predictions and candidate truth coverage.
prospective_population.target_mix: Freeze strata from the full unlabelled public test metadata; never optimize strata to reproduce prior leaderboard signs.
prospective_population.chemistry: Freeze transitive groups from official identity, scaffold, formula and Morgan Tanimoto>=0.70; no group crosses train/selection/source-confirmation splits.
prospective_population.exposure: Audit exact and near acquisition matches and documented training/reference identities for every adopted model. Unknown pretraining exposure must be reported, not assumed absent.
prospective_population.missing_support: An absent target stratum or source cannot be repaired with infinite weights, repeated molecules, or resampling; report the gap and obtain new qualifying acquisitions.
prospective_population.endpoints: All-query MRR@25 with absent truth zero; candidate recall@25, true-top1 gains/losses, recovered/displaced answers; paired chemistry-cluster uncertainty by source and polarity.
prospective_population.decision: Freeze one complete pipeline candidate before source outcomes. Require material supported development gain and no adverse source/polarity point result; separately disclose uncertainty. Use a never-consumed independent confirmation only after those checks.
prospective_population.interim: Current panels remain diagnostic. No claim of a representative or leaderboard-calibrated panel until source and covariate support plus exposure audits pass.
prospective_population.c13: Existing untouched C13 stays sealed; this audit does not establish that it matches target acquisition support.
